{{Top|leg}}
'''Illuninescences''' were organic material that glowed in the dark. On [[Oshetti IV]], [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] living in hemp produced a glow, with different strains of bacteria producing different colors. The swamp hemp of Oshetti was dried and spun into fine cloth.<ref name="HS">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>
